name: Thanksgiving Day Sunday schedule
detail: Sunday service 8am to midnight; all five lines run until 9pm, three lines 9pm to midnight. Parking free at stations except Milpitas and Berryessa/North San Jose.
source_quote: BART will operate on a Sunday schedule for Thanksgiving

name: Day after Thanksgiving regular weekday service
detail: Regular weekday hours 5am to midnight; not a parking holiday.

name: Transbay Tube single tracking, Saturday night Nov 21
detail: Lighting work starts 10pm Saturday Nov 21 and continues through end of service that night; two tracks reduced to one, trains every 30 min systemwide, only Blue, Yellow, Orange run (no Red or Green), Yellow shuttle SFO-Millbrae.
source_quote: next happen on Saturday, November 21 at 10pm and continue through the end of service that night

name: Transbay Tube single tracking all day Sunday Dec 6
detail: All-day lighting work, Transbay Tube reduced to one track. Trains about every 30 min systemwide; only Blue, Yellow, Orange lines; Red and Green do not operate; Yellow Line shuttle SFO-Millbrae all day, riders beyond SFO must transfer. Page gives no clock hours beyond 'the entire day'.
source_quote: Red and Green Line service will not operate

name: Yellow Line late-night single tracking Lafayette-Walnut Creek
detail: Single tracking from midnight until service starts; 20-30 minute delays on work nights. Page says dates are updated continually. The URL slug carries a 2025 id but the page content is dated 11.20.26 and lists 2026 dates.
source_quote: November 23, 2026; December 3-5; December 7; December 17-19; and December 21

name: Yellow Line late-night Digital Railway work North Concord/Martinez to Pittsburg/Bay Point
detail: Overnight single tracking starting just before midnight; 10-15 minute delays from midnight; may delay final train transfers (Grand Meet at MacArthur, Antioch DMU transfer). More dates may be added.

name: Powell St. 4th and Market (south side) entrance closed for escalator replacement
